The '''Baradis School of Technology''' was an elite, private school that was used as a front for training criminals. They offered a wide training program, and criminals wishing to acquire specific skills were welcome at Baradis. Baradis was part of the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss Syndicate]].
